TOTAL TRANSITION MATRIX

A rigorous DFA must define an explicit transition for every symbol σ ∈ Σ at every state q ∈ Q. Our matrix δ(q, σ) is complete across all 30 state-symbol pairs and compiles into a flat contiguous lookup table in hardware memory.

THEOREM 2: MYHILL-NERODE MINIMALITY PROOF

Under the Myhill-Nerode theorem, language L creates exactly 6 pairwise distinguishable equivalence classes: [ε], [LEVEL], [LEVEL IP], [LEVEL IP USER], [LEVEL IP USER STATUS], and [ANOMALY]. Therefore, no DFA with fewer than 6 states can recognize L.
